svg.title: Layers that keep an AI coding agent inside its lane
svg.desc: Managed settings on the Mac: root-owned, so the agent has no write access to its own rules; sandbox on for every session; Repo permission rules: auto and bypass modes off; deny merges, force pushes, tags, secrets, settings; ask before every push; OS sandbox: no reads of keys or career data; writes only in the repo; network limited to an allowlist; Tests that pin every rule: a missing rule or a stray allow rule fails the build; each guard mutation-checked; Pull request checks: zizmor, Semgrep, gitleaks, pip-audit, Scorecard, and a Claude review; Rulesets and a human merge: strict required checks, squash only; Dusten applies settings and merges
svg.text: Six layers, none of them trusted alone
A deny rule is a guardrail, not a sandbox; the sandbox is not a review; the review is not a merge.
root-owned, so the agent has no write access to its own rules; sandbox on for every session
auto and bypass modes off; deny merges, force pushes, tags, secrets, settings; ask before every push
no reads of keys or career data; writes only in the repo; network limited to an allowlist
a missing rule or a stray allow rule fails the build; each guard mutation-checked
zizmor, Semgrep, gitleaks, pip-audit, Scorecard, and a Claude review
strict required checks, squash only; Dusten applies settings and merges
